name: Kateinai Kaizou!! Ecchi na Ane no Tsukurikata
original_name: 家庭内改造!! エッチな姉の作り方
source:
Break down big sister, domestic-style!!

A high-ranking career woman with a good reputation
... at least in the company of others...
at home this big sister is a disrespectful, mean jerk
especially to her little brother.

When their father is reassigned overseas,
their mother is only too happy to go with him to
escape home life with an insufferable daughter...

She'll going to make little brother's life a living hell...

So he takes action first. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE187265.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
从家里开始，彻底改造姐姐！

她是位地位颇高、声誉良好的职场女性。
……至少，在外人面前是这样……
可一回到家，这位姐姐就变得傲慢无礼，尤其喜欢刁难弟弟。

父亲被调往海外工作时，
母亲也乐得随他同行，
好摆脱与这个难以忍受的女儿同住的生活……

姐姐眼看就要把弟弟的生活变成地狱……

于是，他决定先下手为强。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE187265.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
